plain: Greys and graphite now lean slightly blue (midnight) and the dark page is #060a13 instead of pure black, so check any screen that pairs HDS greys with your own hard-coded greys or black.

neutral.black is now #060a13 (midnight), not #000000; use your own #000000 where you need true black.
Dark muted fills (surface.muted) moved to the new neutral.750 step so they stay distinct from cards; if you set this variable yourself, check it in dark mode.
Dark cards (surface.raised) moved to the new neutral.825 step so they stay distinct from the midnight page; if you set this variable yourself, check your cards in dark mode.
